title: Proposal: autocomplete=webfinger

labels.name: needs implementer interest
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires implementers to express interest

body:
### What problem are you trying to solve?

[WebFinger](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc7033/) is an _email like_ identifier used on the [Open Social Web](https://swicg.github.io/activitypub-webfinger/) which allows discovery of a user's public profile URL

All types of organizations and platforms typically collect some information about users via forms, and it has become increasingly common for websites to request this web identifier as a way to link to a user's public social web presence.




### What solutions exist today?

The current challenge is that web authors can not rely on any existing autocomplete value, as email and username are often linked with password managers and may try to fill the field with a username or email address.

### How would you solve it?

A standard token would let sites clearly mark a field and let browsers offer a stored value consistently, instead of relying on labels or site-specific heuristics. 

This could make connecting accounts, and discovering a person’s profile faster and less error-prone. WebFinger already provides a machine-readable way to identify and discover accounts; the token would simply tell autofill what kind of value the field expects. 

### Anything else?

_No response_
